assets.prompt:
Edit IMAGE 1, the small wide IRON CHEST ARMOR sprite, into a RATTAN / VINE-WOVEN CHEST ARMOR sprite. Image 1 is the exact pose, scale and silhouette template: retain its WIDE SHORT torso, left-facing three-quarter projection, sloped open neckline, two short shoulder guards, their near/far asymmetry, and the short waist. Output only one EMPTY WEARABLE EQUIPMENT LAYER in the same wide-short composition on TRUE TRANSPARENCY. Coarse logical pixel art: only 27 pixels wide by 13 pixels high; each logical pixel a large crisp square. Do not draw a tall frontal product vest. Image 2 is the body for fitting/alignment ONLY; exclude all person pixels. Image 3 is the user's iron-suit screenshot for the approved apparent bulk, worn angle and pixel quality only, no UI/night lighting.
Change iron material into matte handwoven dried plant rattan: broad tan / muted ochre flexible strips, THREE clear thick horizontal woven bands crossed by only a few wide vertical strips, dark brown liner visible through a few broad gaps, small shoulder pads made of the same broad woven strips and secured with plant-fiber ties. Preserve the iron template's short side-facing torso geometry and shoulder-to-waist proportions, transparent neck and arm openings. Material should read immediately as broad rough basket weave rather than vertical wooden planks, leather or metal. Desaturated straw-tan, olive-brown shadows, a few muted ivory-tan highlights, dark brown-black contour matching input 1's weight. Use large continuous pixel shapes and controlled sparse shading at the same native detail level as iron armor. No fine checker weave, no tiny noisy fibers, no shiny gold, no gradients, no white glints, no blur or antialiasing. No back plate or collar filling the open neck hole, no long straps, no loose dangling vines, no torso-length extension, no skin/person/mannequin/head/face/hair/hands/legs, no other gear, no cast shadow, aura, background, grid, text, logo. The whole shape should look like the iron chest armor fitted to the same small character, rebuilt in rattan.
